story.text: Mrs. Smith, Anne’s {POOR}, crippled friend, hears that Anne will marry Mr. Elliot, and tells her the truth at last. He led her husband into {DEBT} and {RUIN}, then {ABANDONED} the widow. She shows Anne an old {LETTER} in which he mocks Sir Walter. Now he courts Anne only to stop Mrs. Clay {MARRYING} her father, and to keep his {TITLE}.
story.caption: Such a letter could not be read without putting Anne in a glow
